title: Auto Loans: funding window and latest first due date

# Auto Loans: funding window and latest first due date

This quick reference covers two timing settings of each Auto Loans product at PCB: the funding window, meaning the calendar days after application within which an approved loan must fund, and the latest first due date, meaning the most calendar days after funding at which the first installment may fall due.

| Auto Loans product | Funding window (calendar days after application) | Latest first due date (calendar days after funding) |
|---|---|---|
| Used Vehicle Loan | 30 | 45 |
| Certified Pre-Owned Vehicle Loan | 30 | 45 |
| Auto Refinance Loan | 30 | 45 |
| Lease Buyout Loan | 45 | 45 |
| New Vehicle Loan | 30 | 45 |
| Green Vehicle Loan | 30 | 45 |

Both settings are whole numbers of calendar days, not business days.

## Points of judgement

**Is the funding window the same on every product?** No. The Lease Buyout Loan allows 45 calendar days; the other five products allow 30.

**Is the latest first due date the same on every product?** Yes, 45 calendar days after funding on all six products.

**Lookup illustration (hypothetical):** for an Auto Refinance Loan the window setting reads 30 days and the first-due-date setting reads 45 days; for a Lease Buyout Loan both settings read 45 days.
